about: Looks waiting for their catalog photo, each a FaceLook and its written makeup. scripts/gpu/new_looks.py draws each onto public/makeup/looks/no-makeup.webp with FLUX 3 Image Klein (or paste FRAME there with its makeup into ChatGPT's image editing, with that photo); the chosen picture becomes public/makeup/looks/<id>.webp, the look moves into makeup-styles.ts, and scripts/tinybeauty/add_looks.py makes its files.
